CREATE TABLE job_customer_link_events (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), old_customer_id VARCHAR(64) REFERENCES customers(id), new_customer_id VARCHAR(64) REFERENCES customers(id), actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER job_customer_link_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON job_customer_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Customer link history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER job_customer_link_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON job_customer_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Customer link history is immutable'); END
